description: Route to the best service and execute the API call. Returns result with metadata (service used, cost, latency).

constraint.description: Cost constraint: 'free' = only free services, 'cheapest' = prefer lowest cost, 'any' = best overall

input.description: Service-specific input (e.g. { query: 'Berlin' } for geocoding, { text: 'Hello', target: 'de' } for translation)

region.description: Preferred region, e.g. 'eu', 'us'. Omit for global.

name: execute
